# Grid Collection

> Grid Collection is a free logic puzzle game for iPhone (Android coming soon). One rule, eight directions, 95,000 levels: start on any orange cell and jump a fixed distance each move (3 cells straight or 2 cells diagonally) until every active cell is filled exactly once.

- Levels: 95,000, every one solvable to 100%
- Grid sizes: 6 (5×5, 6×6, 7×7, 8×8, 9×9, 10×10) plus 136 Extreme levels up to 20×20
- Stages: 55, ordered by active-cell count, easy to hard
- Stars: one at 80%, two at 90%, three at 100%; finish without an undo for the perfect badge
- Helpers: the right starting cell, or 25%, 50% or 75% of the solution
- Daily reward, a milestone reward every 5 levels, Game Center leaderboard
- No sign-up: progress stays on the device
- Languages: 16 (English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Vietnamese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese)
- Price: free on the App Store (in-app purchases and ads)
